nodes.label: Phase 1 seeded corpus (384 grid points, 5 floats, 150 samples, 30 positions, 3 advisories)
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 seeded corpus (384 grid points, 5 floats, 150 samples, 30 positions, 3 advisories)
nodes.rationale: The grid's single timestamp is a known seeding gap; /api/ocean-data/axes will correctly report one entry and no endpoint should assume more than one.

nodes.label: Never Return JPA Entities From Controllers
nodes.norm_label: never return jpa entities from controllers
nodes.rationale: Controllers always map to a model/ DTO even when fields look identical today, keeping the wire contract decoupled from the persistence schema.

nodes.label: DTO record with static from(Entity) factory convention
nodes.norm_label: dto record with static from(entity) factory convention
nodes.rationale: Controllers stay thin and map JPA entities to model/ records via static from(...) factories so no entity ever leaves a controller. This phase establishes the DTO conventions every later phase copies.

nodes.label: @MockitoBean replaces @MockBean under Spring Boot 4
nodes.rationale: @MockBean is removed in Boot 4, so @WebMvcTest slices must use org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean. Boot 4.1.1 is very new; prefer the Boot 4 reference over Boot 3.x habits when slice behaviour differs.

nodes.label: Postgres on host port 5433
nodes.rationale: A native postgresql-x64-18 service already owns 5432 on the development machine, so the Docker Postgres is published on 5433 and started with docker compose up -d postgres from the repo root.

nodes.label: Testcontainers Postgres over H2 for repository tests
nodes.norm_label: testcontainers postgres over h2 for repository tests
nodes.rationale: The null-guard filter parameters have dialect-specific type inference that H2 would not exercise, so @DataJpaTest slices run against a real PostgreSQL 16 container instead of an in-memory database.

nodes.rationale: CSV downloads the currently-loaded grid via a backend export endpoint; 'Copy link' encodes current view state into the URL rather than persisting a share record.

nodes.label: Two-State Auth Model (Public vs ADMIN)
nodes.rationale: Only 'public' and 'ADMIN' exist. A richer Forecaster/role-hierarchy model with employee directory and designation/grade fields was explicitly tried and rolled back as unnecessary complexity. Role hierarchies must not be reintroduced.

nodes.label: No Public Hazard Ticker on Home
nodes.norm_label: no public hazard ticker on home
nodes.rationale: Hazard advisories feed only Dashboard's HazardLayerToggle and Settings' HazardAdvisoryManager. A public ticker on Home was tried and removed.

nodes.label: AlongTrackSectionService
nodes.rationale: Joins FloatPositionEntity path geometry to ProfileSampleEntity readings to produce distance-along-path sections — the one chart that needs both instrument tables at once.

nodes.label: Seed Multiple Profile Snapshots Per Float
nodes.norm_label: seed multiple profile snapshots per float
nodes.rationale: ProfileSampleEntity must be seeded with several timestamps per float, and FloatPositionEntity must hold real position history rather than faking a path from a single lat/lon — otherwise Time Series, Hovmoller and trajectory rendering have nothing to draw.

nodes.label: Recommended Build Order (Backend Seed First, AI Last)
nodes.norm_label: recommended build order (backend seed first, ai last)
nodes.rationale: Seeded realistic multi-timestamp data comes before any frontend component; the AI Assistant is deliberately last because it depends on every other endpoint already existing.

nodes.label: THREDDS/GeoServer Sidecars Not Yet in Compose
nodes.norm_label: thredds/geoserver sidecars not yet in compose
nodes.rationale: The compose file currently declares only Postgres, although the spec calls for Postgres + THREDDS + GeoServer; the sidecar wiring is the last build-order step.

nodes.label: LLM Extracts Intent Only, Never Data
nodes.norm_label: llm extracts intent only, never data
nodes.rationale: The LLM is used only to extract variable/location/instrument/time-range/chart-type intent. Every number or chart shown must trace back to a real call into the same endpoints Dashboard uses, so the assistant can never hallucinate an oceanographic value.

nodes.label: No Separate /about Route (Documentation Section Replaces It)
nodes.norm_label: no separate /about route (documentation section replaces it)
nodes.rationale: The Home Documentation section (external links to ARCHITECTURE.md and the two user manuals) absorbed everything the removed About page held.

nodes.label: TSDiagramChart
nodes.rationale: Water-mass identification plot that deliberately reuses the depth-profile data already fetched, so switching to it costs no request.

nodes.label: FloatGliderMarkers
nodes.rationale: One dot per instrument at its most recent known position, color-coded blue for float and orange for glider.

nodes.label: Geo Map Is a Path Viewer, Not a Simplified 3D Tour
nodes.norm_label: geo map is a path viewer, not a simplified 3d tour
nodes.rationale: Geo Map renders a standard 2D tile map instead of a 3D scene; it was re-scoped from a simplified 3D tour into a dedicated instrument path-tracking view.

nodes.label: Public Signup, Always Inactive Until Approved
nodes.norm_label: public signup, always inactive until approved
nodes.rationale: POST /api/auth/signup is public but the created UserEntity has active=false and cannot log in until an existing admin approves it, so open signup never widens the admin trust boundary.

nodes.label: GET /api/admin/users/pending, POST .../approve, POST .../reject
nodes.rationale: Approve sets active=true; Reject deletes the account outright rather than leaving a dormant record.

nodes.label: Seeded First Admin Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Signup always produces active=false accounts that need an existing admin's approval, which creates a bootstrap deadlock. DataSeeder creating one pre-activated admin from application.yml config on first startup is what breaks that deadlock — there must always be at least one admin able to approve others.

nodes.label: ChatMessageList
nodes.rationale: New messages are appended optimistically as they are sent, with session history loaded once on mount.

nodes.label: Home / Dashboard / Geo Map / AI Assistant Are Fully Public
nodes.norm_label: home / dashboard / geo map / ai assistant are fully public
nodes.rationale: Only Data Manager and Profile & Settings are gated; the analytical and outreach surfaces stay login-free forever to satisfy the public-accessibility deliverable.

nodes.label: Read-only ProfileSampleRepository exception to CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md lists no repository for ProfileSampleEntity because it is reached through ArgoFloatEntity's cascade. That holds for writes — the cascade still owns persistence. A read-only query repository is needed because the point of the sub-resource decision is fetching samples without loading the parent's LAZY collection. Deliberate, narrow exception: no save or delete usage.

nodes.label: Decision: Argo data exposed as sub-resources
nodes.norm_label: decision: argo data exposed as sub-resources
nodes.rationale: FloatSelector populating a dropdown must not drag 36 child rows per float. Both @OneToMany collections are LAZY; sub-resources let each endpoint touch only the tables it needs. Rejected a fat resource, and a fat resource with an include= parameter (a query language in disguise, with a DTO shape that varies by request). Consequence: ArgoFloat's counts and observation bounds must come from a projection query, never from walking the LAZY collections.

nodes.label: Decision: bare JSON array responses, no data/meta envelope
nodes.norm_label: decision: bare json array responses, no data/meta envelope
nodes.rationale: Chart.js and the Three.js layers consume arrays directly, and corpus metadata already has a home in /api/stats, so an envelope would add indirection without a consumer.

nodes.label: Deferral: CorsConfig
nodes.rationale: Vite proxies /api to :8080, so nothing needs CORS until the frontend exists in Phase 3.

nodes.label: Public read-only REST surface (auth deferred to Phase 6)
nodes.norm_label: public read-only rest surface (auth deferred to phase 6)
nodes.rationale: Every Phase 2 endpoint is public and read-only; no security annotations are added because authentication arrives in Phase 6 and must not be anticipated by this work.

nodes.label: Decision: single bounding-box + depth + time filter endpoint
nodes.norm_label: decision: single bounding-box + depth + time filter endpoint
nodes.rationale: All filter parameters optional; omission means unbounded. Rejected returning the whole grid for client-side filtering (hard-codes an assumption that the grid stays small, which real INCOIS data breaks) and rejected splitting into separate depth-slice and point-query routes (multiplies endpoints before there is a consumer). One filter record is shared by /api/ocean-data and /api/stats/variables so both agree on what a filter means.

nodes.label: Deferral: springdoc / Swagger UI
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md calls for springdoc-openapi, but springdoc 2.x targets Boot 3.x while this project is on Boot 4.1.1. Landing the endpoints first and resolving the version question in a focused task avoids a dependency fight blocking Phase 2.

nodes.label: Decision: stats split into summary and variables
nodes.norm_label: decision: stats split into summary and variables
nodes.rationale: /api/stats/summary carries constant corpus counters for Home's LiveMetricsPanel; /api/stats/variables carries filtered aggregates for the AI Assistant and colorScale.js. Different shapes and different cache characteristics; folding them together makes Home pay for aggregate math it never renders.

nodes.label: React Compiler left disabled in template
nodes.norm_label: react compiler left disabled in template
nodes.rationale: The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev and build performance; enabling it is an opt-in documented upstream.

nodes.rationale: FloatSelector, ArgoMarkers and the Geo Map all read the same selected-float state, so a selection made in one zone follows the user across the app.

nodes.rationale: Exists to show the platform is not running on synthetic demo data alone.

nodes.label: DataSourceStatusPanel (admin operational view)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately distinct from Home's public-facing DataSourcesPanel: shows last successful check-in per source for admins diagnosing ingestion issues.

nodes.label: JPQL null-guard filter idiom
nodes.rationale: Chosen over JPA Specifications because Specifications do not compose cleanly onto the aggregate projection /api/stats/variables needs, and one filter idiom is better than two. Known risk: Hibernate may need an explicit cast(:minLat as Double) on Postgres to infer null-guard parameter types — mechanical to fix, not a design change.

nodes.norm_label: fr-5 instrument overlay (argo, glider, ctd, bgc)

nodes.label: SuggestedQueryChips
nodes.rationale: Clicking a chip only fills the input; it never auto-sends, so the user stays in control of what is queried.

nodes.label: Postgres 16 Compose Service (deepsync-postgres)
nodes.rationale: Published on host port 5433 rather than 5432 to avoid colliding with a locally installed Postgres; db/user/password are all 'deepsync' and data persists in the deepsync-postgres-data named volume.

nodes.label: ControlPanel (variable, colorbar, depth slice, exaggeration, opacity)
nodes.norm_label: controlpanel (variable, colorbar, depth slice, exaggeration, opacity)

nodes.label: IsosurfaceLayer
nodes.rationale: Runs marching cubes client-side over the already-fetched grid — no backend call.

nodes.label: CF Conventions Compliance (Validated at Ingestion Time)
nodes.norm_label: cf conventions compliance (validated at ingestion time)
nodes.rationale: CF validation happens before a NetCDF file is accepted, so malformed model output is rejected at the boundary instead of corrupting the grid store.

nodes.label: Eight-Chart 2D Analytical Suite
nodes.rationale: All eight chart types sit behind one ChartTypeSelector so the 2D zone stays a single container rather than eight competing panels, and the AI Assistant can reuse the same renderers.

nodes.label: Parser Plugin Extensibility Pattern
nodes.rationale: A new ingestion format is added by implementing OceanDataParser and registering it as a @Component; ParserRegistry auto-collects it. Format if/else branching must never appear anywhere else in the codebase.

nodes.label: Chart Component Reuse Across Dashboard, Geo Map and Chat
nodes.norm_label: chart component reuse across dashboard, geo map and chat
nodes.rationale: ChatChartRenderer and InstrumentDetailPanel both render existing Dashboard chart components rather than new drawing code; one dispatcher covers all eight chart types.

nodes.label: Client-Side Recompute Instead of Refetch
nodes.rationale: Variable recolor, depth slicing, isosurface marching-cubes, streamlines, histogram binning, region selection and map filtering all operate on already-fetched data; new requests are issued only for genuinely new data (timestamp change, multi-timestamp profile history, along-track sections). Keeps interaction latency off the network.

nodes.label: All Four Application Flows Converge on One Postgres Store
nodes.norm_label: all four application flows converge on one postgres store
nodes.rationale: Ingestion (admin), public visitor access, AI query and admin auth all read/write the same Postgres store, so data ingested once is immediately visible everywhere it is used.
